name: wolverine-review-hard
request: Review this change before we merge it. Customer service booked every parcel by hand. Now, when the payments service reports a captured payment, the service books the parcel with the parcel platform, with the shipping speed of the customer, and sends the warehouse its pick order. When the carrier refuses the address, the shipment waits for customer service with the status AddressProblem, and customer service books it again with POST /shipments/{id}/book.

assertions.judge: The review finds at least 7 of the 9 planted mistakes.
The review finds every planted mistake with severity 'high' (P1, P2, P8).
The review finds at least 5 of the 8 planted mistakes marked 'subtle' (P1, P2, P3, P5, P6, P7, P8, P9).

The review flags none of the decoys (D1 to D5), and has at most 2 other false positives. A false positive is a claim that is wrong, or a fix that would break the code or that uses an API that does not exist or is outdated (for example RestoreV5Defaults or ServiceLocationPolicy.AllowedButWarn as the fix, UseNativeAck, MassTransit or MediatR interfaces, or UseQuorumQueues() on the existing classic queues without a migration). A real problem that is not on the answer sheet is not a false positive.

For P1, the review says that Wolverine 6 does not discover IForwardsTo by itself and recommends opts.RegisterMessageForwarder<PaymentCaptured, PaymentCapturedV2>() (UseAutomaticForwarderDiscovery() counts only when the review says it is obsolete).
Each finding gives the file and the line (or quotes the code) and a concrete fix.
The review separates blocking issues from minor ones and ends with a clear merge verdict that does not approve the change as it is.
